Package com.bupt.ta.util

Class AppConfig

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.util.AppConfig
public final class AppConfig extends Object
Loads optional WEB-INF/*.properties files and resolves configuration with a fixed priority: environment variable → JVM system property → properties file → default value.

Used at servlet startup and by AI/LM integration to read secrets and feature flags without hard-coding. Missing or unreadable property files are treated as non-fatal empty properties.

Thread-safe for resolve(String, String[], Properties, String, String): reads only immutable environment and system properties. loadWebInfProperties(javax.servlet.ServletContext, java.lang.String) should be called once per context during initialization.

  • Method Details

    • loadWebInfProperties

      public static Properties loadWebInfProperties(javax.servlet.ServletContext ctx, String fileName)
      Loads a UTF-8 properties file from /WEB-INF/{fileName} on the servlet classpath.

      Returns an empty Properties when the context is null, the file name is blank, the resource is missing, or an I/O error occurs (errors are swallowed for optional overrides).

      Parameters:
      ctx - servlet context used to locate WEB-INF resources; may be null
      fileName - file name only, e.g. "lm.properties" (not a full path)
      Returns:
      loaded properties, never null

    • resolve

      public static String resolve(String envVar, String[] sysPropKeys, Properties fileProps, String fileKey, String defaultValue)
      Resolves a configuration string using the first non-blank source in priority order.
      1. Environment variable named envVar (if envVar is non-null)
      2. JVM system properties listed in sysPropKeys, tried in array order
      3. Entry fileKey in fileProps
      4. defaultValue
      Parameters:
      envVar - environment variable name, e.g. "LM_ENABLED"; may be null
      sysPropKeys - system property keys tried in order, e.g. "LM_ENABLED", "lm.enabled"; may be null
      fileProps - properties loaded from WEB-INF; may be null
      fileKey - key within fileProps; may be null
      defaultValue - fallback when no source provides a non-blank value
      Returns:
      trimmed resolved value, or defaultValue (which may be null)
